name: claude-forge
description: Local-only forks of ui-craft, caveman, superpowers, humanizer, computer-commander, and remember (as memory), unity (as unity-dev) and game-trend-skills (as game-trends), plus common-ground

plugins.name: ui-craft
plugins.description: Anti-slop UI design system: discovery-first workflow, layout, typography, color, motion, accessibility, and polish for production interfaces.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts 65% of output tokens (measured) while keeping full technical accuracy by speaking like a caveman.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Process skills for brainstorming, planning, TDD, systematic debugging, and parallel agent dispatch.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text, making it sound more natural and human. Based on Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing" guide.

plugins.name: computer-commander
plugins.description: Terminal, process and filesystem MCP server. Local fork of Desktop Commander pinned to upstream v0.2.52, telemetry and remote feature-flag fetch removed at source, run from local disk with node.

plugins.name: common-ground
plugins.description: Assumption ledger, decision history, and Mermaid reasoning map for the current project. Standalone adaptation of Common Ground from Jeffallan/claude-skills.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Continuous memory for Claude Code: tiered daily logs and session handoffs. Fork of claude-remember 0.43.1, renamed to memory so it can be installed next to the official remember plugin.

plugins.name: unity-dev
plugins.description: Unity Technologies agent skills (UI Toolkit, uGUI, 2D, tilemaps, URP, IAP, multiplayer, localization). Fork of unity-agent-plugin 0.1.8-beta, renamed so it installs next to the official unity plugin. Unity Companion License.

plugins.name: game-trends
plugins.description: Mobile game trend scans, idea brainstorming and scoring, KPI tracking, agent build briefs, zero-budget launch plans. Fork of malicaki/game-trend-skills 0.1.0, renamed to game-trends.
